import { test, expect } from '@playwright/test';
import { resetAndSeed } from '../support/seed';

// The money owed on the home screen now counts only invoices that have been SENT (not drafts, not
// paid). Drafts are excluded from the outstanding figure.
test.describe('outstanding counts sent invoices only', () => {
  test('the outstanding total excludes drafts', { tag: '@functionality' }, async ({ page }) => {
    await resetAndSeed({
      clients: [{ id: 1, name: 'Acme Ltd', email: 'ops@acme.example' }],
      projects: [{ id: 1, name: 'Website Rebuild', clientId: 1 }],
      invoices: [
        { id: 1, projectId: 1, amount: 100, status: 'SENT' },
        { id: 2, projectId: 1, amount: 50, status: 'DRAFT' },
        { id: 3, projectId: 1, amount: 200, status: 'SENT' },
        { id: 4, projectId: 1, amount: 30, status: 'PAID' },
      ],
    });
    await page.goto('/');
    await page.getByTestId('nav-dashboard').click();

    // 100 + 200 sent-and-unpaid; the 50 draft and 30 paid are excluded.
    await expect(page.getByTestId('dashboard-outstanding-total')).toHaveText('$300.00');
  });
});

content.text:
The app already worked this way, so no real change was needed. The amount owed on the dashboard already counts only sent invoices; drafts and paid invoices are left out. `DashboardService.summary()` adds up only invoices with status `SENT`, via `InvoiceRepository.sumAmountByStatus(InvoiceStatus.SENT)`.

The test passed on the first run of `bin/e2e`, before I edited anything. With sent invoices of $100 and $200, a $50 draft and a $30 paid invoice, the dashboard shows **$300.00** under the existing `dashboard-outstanding-total` test ID.

I didn't change the database, the server or how the page works. The only edit is a code comment in `src/main/frontend/src/app/features/dashboard/dashboard.ts`, which said the total was "all unpaid invoices". That wording would include drafts, so it now says the total is invoices that have been sent but not yet paid, with drafts not counted. The test still passes after the edit.

The task mentioned an OfficeFloor server, but the server here is a standard Spring Boot app. That made no difference to this change.
